stories.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
stories.body: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

stories.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
stories.body: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

stories.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
stories.body: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

stories.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
stories.body: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

stories.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
stories.body: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

stories.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
stories.body: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

stories.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
stories.body: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

stories.title: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
stories.body: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

stories.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
stories.body: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.

stories.title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
stories.body: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.

stories.title: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
stories.body: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

stories.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
stories.body: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.

stories.title: Severe Thanksgiving storms leave roads flooded and trees fallen
stories.body: Hundreds of thousands of people were without power after severe weather hit both coasts of the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday.

stories.title: 'It's impossible': Spain's young people on housing ahead of Sunday's election
stories.body: Europe correspondent Nick Beake speaks to one couple kept apart by high rents in Valencia.

stories.title: Zelensky questions 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
stories.body: The Ukrainian president tells the BBC that Russia's Vladimir Putin should not be treated as a friend.

stories.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
stories.body: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

stories.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
stories.body: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.

stories.title: Behind China's spectacular rise, voices who defied it say they are being drowned out
stories.body: China's immense clout now also has the flex of soft power. Critics and dissidents say their voices are being drowned out.

stories.title: A clinic is reassessing people with ADHD and autism diagnoses - but critics fear it could deepen stigma
stories.body: While many people find a diagnosis for ADHD or autism affirming, a government-funded clinic in Sweden is re-assessing people who feel it does not reflect them.

stories.title: The Indian 'Tamasha queen' whose fans paid for a show that never happened
stories.body: A new Bollywood flim spotlights the remarkable life of dancer and singer Vithabhai Narayangaonkar.
